Select the option in which the numbers are **NOT related **in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(63, 76, 46)
questions.solution:
Given: (63, 76, 46)

The Logic followed here is:

**1st number**

**2ⁿd number = 1st number + 13**

**3rd number = 2ⁿd number - 30**

Now follow these steps,

1st number → 63

2ⁿd number = 63 + 13 = 76

3rd number = 76 - 30 = 46

We get, (63, 76, 46)

**Now we check all the options-**

**Option (1): **(45, 58, 28)

1st number → 45

2ⁿd number = 45 + 13 = 58

3rd number = 58 - 30 = 28

We get, (45, 58, 28)

**Option (2): **(83, 96, 66)

1st number → 83

2ⁿd number = 83 + 13 = 96

3rd number = 96 - 30 = 66

We get, (83, 96, 66)

**Option (3): **(69, 84, 52)

**1st number → 69**

**2ⁿd number = 69 + 13 = 82 ≠ 84**

**3rd number = 82 - 30 = 52**

**We get, (69, 82, 52)**

**But option (3) given (69, 84, 52) this option don’t follow the pattern**

**Option (4): **(72, 85, 55)

1st number → 72

2ⁿd number = 72 + 13 = 85

3rd number = 85 - 30 = 55

We get, (72, 85, 55)

**Hence, option (3) is the correct answer.**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'LOWER' is coded as '186' and 'MULISH' is coded as '320'. How will 'OPTIONAL' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
**The table is alphabets place value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is: 

**Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of consonant in word = number.**

**LOWER →** Total number of consonant (L, W, R) in the word is 3. 

Opposite alphabets of Given word is OLDVI

Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters →

O(15) + L(12) + D(4) + V(22) + I(9) = 15 + 12 + 4 + 22 + 9 = 62

Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of consonant in word = number

62 × 3 = 186

And,

**MULISH →** Total number of consonant (M, L, S, H) in word is 4. 

Opposite alphabets of Given word is NFORHS

Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters →

N(14) + F(6) + O(15) + R(18) + H(8) + S(19) = 14 + 6 + 15 + 18 + 8 + 19 = 80

Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of consonant in word = number

80 × 4 = 320

Similarly,

**OPTIONAL → Total number of consonant (P, T, N, L) in word is 4. **

**Opposite alphabets of Given word is LKGRLMZO**

**Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters →**

**L(12) + K(11) + G(7) + R(18) + L(12) + M(13) + Z(26) + O(15) = 12 + 11 + 7 + 18 + 12 + 13 + 26 + 15 = 114**

**Sum of the positional values of the opposite alphabets letters × Total number of consonant in word = number**

**114 × 4 = 456**

Hence, OPTIONAL will be written as** “456”.**

G_CT_GP_T_GPC_D_PC_D

options.text: P, T, T, D, D, C, G

P, D, C, D, T, G, T

questions.solution:
We put all the option in blank area and check who create particular pattern

**Option (1)** P, T, T, D, D, C, G

G _ C T _ G P _ T _ G P C _ D _ P C _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

G **__P__** C T **__T__** **/ **G P **__T__** T **__D__** **/ **G P C **__D__** D **/ __C__** P C **__G__** D

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

**Option (2)** P, D, D, C, G, T, T

G _ C T _ G P _ T _ G P C _ D _ P C _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

G **__P__** C T **__D__** **/ **G P **__D__** T **__C__** **/ **G P C **__G__** D **/ __T__** P C **__T__** D

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

**Option (3)** P, C, T, D, G, T, D

G _ C T _ G P _ T _ G P C _ D _ P C _ D

After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:

G **__P__** C T **__C__** **/ **G P **__T__** T **__D__** **/ **G P C **__G__** D **/ __T__** P C **__D__** D

No particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence is divided into equal parts.

**Option (4) P, D, C, D, T, G, T**

**G _ C T _ G P _ T _ G P C _ D _ P C _ D**

**After filling the blanks with the letters/numbers in the option given above, we get:**

G **__P__** C T **__D__** **/ **G P **__C__** T **__D__** **/ **G P C **__T__** D **/ __G__** P C **__T__** D

**A particular pattern is repeating itself when the sequence *is divided into equal parts.***

Hence, ***‘P, D, C, D, T, G, T’*** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Two numbers A and B are such that the sum of 3% of A and 6% of B is four-fifths of the sum of 4% of A and 6% of B. Find the ratio of A + B and A - B.
questions.solution:
Given:

Sum of 3% of A and 6% of B is four-fifths of the sum of 4% of A and 6% of B

3% of A + 6% of B = 4/5 × (4% of A + 6% of B)

Both side take percent common;

=> 3 × A + 6 × B = 4/5 × (4 × A + 6 × B)

=> 5 × (3A + 6B) = 4 × (4A + 6B)

=> 15A + 30B = 16A + 24B

=> 16A – 15A = 30B – 24B

=> A = 6B

So, A : B = 6 : 1

Let common factor in A and B is x

A = 6x and B = x

Now,

A + B = 6x + x = 7x

A – B = 6x – x = 5x

The ratio of A + B and A – B is **‘7 : 5’.**
